title: Chapter 110 Covenant
content:
Chapter 110 Covenant

At this moment on the battlefield, all the imperial army, including Sun Jian, after seeing the action of the golden armored god of war, thought that they would die this time, and they would not be spared!

However, just when everyone knew that they couldn't escape and was about to serve the country with death, they didn't expect that the golden-armored god on the other side would actually speak.

"The commander of the humble ants on the opposite side, the great God Vogo needs you to become my believers. If you can surrender and incorporate the army into the Vogo tribe, then I will forgive your crimes and give you the right to live in a humble way!" The tone was as arrogant and conceited as a Westerner as always.

Surrender, the person who is like a god mansion on the opposite side wants to surrender by himself. He also said that he needed to become his believer, that he was still of great use to him, and that he would talk to him like this. Thinking of this, Sun Jian felt a lot more at ease.

"If you want me to surrender, it's not impossible, but I surrender to the great and respected you, not to the weak Vogo tribe, and my army is absolutely impossible to hand over, and it must be separated from the Vogo tribe, Otherwise, you'd better kill us directly!"

"Humble ant, what qualifications do you have to negotiate with the noble and great me? You have only two choices, either surrender or die. The majesty of God Vogo cannot be offended!" Hearing this ant in front of him, he dared to refuse He dared to make demands on himself, and God Woge, who felt very good about himself, was furious in his heart!

"I surrender to you because of your great strength, not because of the weak and ignorant tribe behind you. Surrendering to you is not a disgrace, but another kind of honor, but surrendering to you like that tribe is to us warriors We would rather die than accept such humiliating conditions!"

Speaking of this, Sun Jian's tone was firm and decisive, without any leeway at all. The reason why he wanted to rebel against His Majesty the Emperor before was not only because His Majesty was too cruel, but more because he wanted to be the boss.

He used to risk his life to find the tyrant's rebellion for the sake of independence, but now how could he turn to some barbarians who are more backward and humble than the tyrant for his own life? Give your dignity and loyalty? This is undoubtedly a great insult to his personal dignity, and he would rather die than accept it!

As if in response to Sun Jian, many officers and soldiers behind Sun Jian shouted in unison: "Gods will not descend to barbarians, descending gods will not descend to barbarians!"

The voice was as firm as the tone. They were sent north by their emperor in the Three Kingdoms world and conquered countless barbarians. There was a sense of arrogance in their hearts.

Even in this world where gods and demons are manifested, they have defeated countless such ignorant and backward barbarians in front of them, how could they surrender to the weak who were beaten by themselves and almost begged for mercy!

Seeing the determination of these ants in front of him, God Wo Ge frowned, hesitating in his heart. It is naturally very simple to kill these ants who dare to offend him.

You only need to fight some punishments from heaven and humanity, resolutely use divine power, and eliminate these ants. But this is not in line with my original purpose!

I want to subdue these ants, let them become my followers, and conquer more land and plunder more people for myself.

To spread one's beliefs to a wider area, to help one's Shinto practice, to go further, this is what he really needs!

If you kill these ants and continue to cultivate yourself, it will be of no avail. Instead, you will suffer some damage to your body due to the backlash of heaven and humanity, which is too much for the gain.

His own Vogo tribe has lost a lot of population, and the entire alliance has also consumed a lot after this campaign.

After such a war, the war potential and strength of the entire Andel Alliance were almost exhausted.

If there is nothing else to add, then it is absolutely no accident that the other two major forces beat the dog in the water and ceded land for compensation, and it is not impossible to be annexed by them.

On the contrary, if they can get the support and trust of these ants in front of them, then the loss of the entire tribe before can be ignored, and on the contrary, it will benefit a lot, and their strength will go further.

With the beliefs of these ants in front of him, and taking advantage of the current chaos to annex more small tribes and gain more beliefs, then his own path of igniting the divine fire and becoming a true god will go one step further.

Thinking about it this way, it seems that it is more beneficial for me to accept their conditions!

But I can't let it go like this, the majesty of being a god's mansion cannot accommodate any invasion of ants. It is necessary for this ants commander to give himself a good reason, so that he can have a step down.

"Mortal, if you want me to accept your conditions, you must show that you have the ability and benefits of this value condition, otherwise, you just wait to accept the wrath of the great God Vogo!" With a trace of murderous aura, the sky and the earth became dark following the words of God Wo Ge, and the sky darkened!

"My value and condition is to help you control these 40,000 people, make them believe in you, and help you to receive the loyalty of hundreds of thousands of people in the kingdom behind me. With these, then you can use these It is not impossible to become the fourth largest force on the entire plain!"

Sun Jian followed the anger of the God Wo Ge, not only did not have any fear in his heart, but became more calm and calm. As soon as the words of the God Wo Ge fell, he quickly responded loudly.

Hearing Sun Jian's words, God Wo Ge began to think carefully. With the loyalty of hundreds of thousands of people, with their beliefs, it is absolutely no problem to ignite the fire by himself, and even go further, to condense the godhead and become a true god. Not impossible!

Moreover, looking at the appearance of these people, their civilization and technological advancement seem to be no different from those kingdoms in the center of the entire continent.

It is even more advanced, and the civilization is more brilliant. If I can rely on this commander to accept all the immigrant heritage of that kingdom.

After decades of nurturing, directly accumulating enough background, unifying the entire plain, and becoming a true god, it will definitely no longer be fantasy and illusion.

"Well, humble mortal, rejoice, your words have moved me, I accept your terms, you will become my believer as the second independent force under my command, full of glory. But, remember your Promise, if you break it, I will let you understand how serious the consequences of deceiving a god are, not just one person can explain it!" God Wo Ge's tone was gentle at first, but then became serious.

"Of course, how dare I deceive the great and honorable His Highness Shendi! I will definitely do my best to spread the glory of His Highness Shendi!"

When Sun Jian heard this, the hanging heart in his heart finally let go, and he couldn't help but respond with confidence and flattery. This future in front of him may always be the great existence of his master.

In the end, under the angry and resentful eyes of Wolf, the patriarch of the Vogo tribe, whether it is the aloof god in front of him or the arrogant commander Sun Jian, they all directly ignored the original intention of the patriarch in front of him and directly began to assign their own Interests!

With the beginning of this human-god covenant, the crisis of the imperial kingdom began to emerge everywhere, and it may collapse at any time!
